title: More than one non-human species, not all benevolent

tellings.quote: another thing uh that not every spec there were more than one species and there weren't all as benevolent as

plain: Richard Barth, a former guard at nuclear missiles, says that during his 1964 encounter with beings at Vandenberg Air Force Base in California he learned there is more than one non-human species, and they are not all as friendly as the ones he met. He tells Michels this as something he took part in, and it is the same encounter in which he says the beings told him they will not allow a nuclear war.
